catalogCompleteness.name: CatalogCompleteness
catalogCompleteness.definition: present required STRUCTURED attributes / applicable required structured attributes; one unit per clean SKU x category requirement. Text in the description never counts.

semanticCoverage.name: SemanticCoverage
semanticCoverage.definition: required attributes present structurally OR supported by explicit text evidence / applicable required attributes; one unit per clean SKU x category requirement. Text evidence counts only when the asserted value equals the authoritative clean-store value, so a misleading description can never raise coverage.

dataConsistency.name: DataConsistency
dataConsistency.definition: passed consistency checks / applicable consistency checks, with the applicable set fixed by the clean store. Checks: catalog stockStatus vs Inventory (per SKU), catalog listedPrice vs Pricing (per SKU), catalog Istanbul delivery promise vs Shipping calculation (per SKU with authoritative stock), description vs authoritative attribute (per product x describable attribute; no claim passes), variant relationship (per variant of a multi-variant category), return-policy cell explicit and authoritative (per cell). A unit whose observed data is missing is NotEvaluable and counts as not passing.
